notes.title: The "Habitable Zone" is here! New level, Entity, Sounds, Subtitles and Bugfixes!
notes.notes:
[b]The "Habitable Zone" is here![/b]
New Level, the Habitable Zone (Level 1) got released!
New Entity is available, the Dullers are here to welcome you in the Backrooms!
New Sounds got implemented as well as new Subtitles for the Story.
Also almost every known bug is fixed for now!
+ V-Sync is now available in the Settings.

Have fun! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/q4J3dgb.png[/img]
